offering_description.value: ADP sells cloud-based payroll and HR software and outsourced employer services to organizations ranging from small businesses to multinational employers. It processes payroll and payroll taxes, administers benefits, and provides co-employment services that handle HR, benefits and workers’ compensation for client businesses.

primary_products.value: payroll software; HR management software; time and attendance software; talent management software; benefits administration software

primary_services.value: payroll processing and tax filing; HR outsourcing and co-employment; employee benefits administration; retirement plan administration; insurance brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small and midsized businesses, multinational employers, nonprofits and private institutions; B2G: Public agencies and public-sector institutions

end_markets.value: professional services; retail and hospitality; healthcare; manufacturing; public administration and education

revenue_model.value: service fees: Payroll processing, tax filing, benefits administration and co-employment services; subscription: Recurring access to cloud payroll and workforce management software; transaction or usage fees: Charges based on payroll runs, employee counts or processing activity; interest or premiums: Interest earned on client payroll and tax funds held before disbursement; commissions or management fees: Commissions on insurance policies placed for client employers
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; transaction or usage fees; interest or premiums; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses employer payroll and personnel data to process pay, file taxes and administer benefits for organizations; software / platform: Provides employers with cloud software that integrates payroll, timekeeping and HR records; financial intermediary: Handles employer funds for payroll and tax payments and places insurance for client businesses
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada, with operations and clients across Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Payroll and HR software, outsourced payroll, co-employment, benefits and retirement administration, and insurance brokerage

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Dedicated sales teams serving small businesses, midsized employers and enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: Referrals from accounting firms, banks and other business partners; online: Website inquiries and quote requests for payroll and HR services

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensing or registration for insurance brokerage and co-employment, plus payroll tax, benefits and data privacy rules
